I did not have the repository files, so this edit is a guess and untested. I assumed the agent definitions live in `internal/skills/registry/registry.go` and that the Codex entry uses `UserDir:    ".codex/skills",` with that exact spacing. If the path or alignment differs, the SEARCH block will not match and needs adjusting.

The change points Codex's user-scope directory at `.agents/skills`, matching project scope. I did not touch `gh skill list` / `update`, so skills already installed under `~/.codex/skills` will no longer be recognised by them.
